|}

|-
|style="font-size: 0.9em"|
*[[Wookieepedia:Discord|Discord]]: for editing help and chatting with fellow editors
*[[Forum:Senate Hall|Senate Hall]]: for dialogue on wiki matters
*[[Forum:Consensus track|Consensus track]]: to vote on policy changes
*[[Wookieepedia:Wookieepedian of the Month|Wookieepedian of the Month]]: to recognize users for exemplary work
*[[Forum:Trash compactor|Trash compactor]]: to vote on article deletions
*[[Wookieepedia:Discussions|Discussions]]: for general chat with other fans
*Learn the lingo by visiting our [[Wookieepedia:Glossary|glossary]]!
|}
{|width="100%" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="3" style="vertical-align: top; table-layout: fixed"
! class="nounderlinelink plainlinks" style="text-align: left; padding: 0px"|
<div class="mp-header">
{|width="100%"
! style="padding-left: 7px; text-align: left;"|[[File:Blue-exclamation-mark.png|25px]] '''USER POLICIES'''
|}
</div>
|-
|style="font-size: 0.9em"|
*Treat other editors with respect. (See [[Wookieepedia:User conduct policy#Civility|WP:CIVIL]] and [[Wookieepedia:User conduct policy#Unacceptable behavior|WP:NPA]])
*Ensure that all content is properly cited to supporting sources. ([[Wookieepedia:Attribution|WP:ATT]] and [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|WP:S]])
*Do not participate in edit warring. (See [[Wookieepedia:User conduct policy#Three-revert rule|WP:3RR]])
*Keep discussions on-topic. (See [[Wookieepedia:Talk page policy|WP:TALK]])
*Follow the site's voting policy. (See [[Wookieepedia:Voting eligibility policy|WP:VOTE]] and [[Wookieepedia:Consensus|WP:CON]])
*Use edit summaries when saving an edit.
*Sign all comments on talk pages and forums using four tildes (<nowiki>~~~~</nowiki>). (See [[Wookieepedia:Signature policy|WP:SIG]])
*Don't disrupt the wiki to prove a point. (See [[Wookieepedia:User conduct policy#Spirit of collaboration|WP:POINT]])
*Continued rule-breaking will result in a block. (See [[Wookieepedia:Blocking policy|WP:BLOCK]])
|}
{|width="100%" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="3" style="vertical-align: top; table-layout: fixed"
! class="nounderlinelink plainlinks" style="text-align: left; padding: 0px"|
<div class="mp-header">
{|width="100%"
! style="padding-left: 7px; text-align: left;"|[[File:Information icon.svg|25px]] '''ARTICLE POLICIES'''
|}
</div>
|-
|style="font-size: 0.9em"|
*[[Wookieepedia:Manual of Style|Manual of Style]]: explains how articles should be written
*[[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide|Layout Guide]]: explains how articles should be organized
*[[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|Sourcing policy]]: explains how and why articles are sourced
*[[Wookieepedia:Canon policy|Canon policy]]: explains what is considered canon/Legends on the wiki
*[[Wookieepedia:Notability policy|Notability policy]]: explains which topics have their own articles
*[[Wookieepedia:Manual of Style#Perspective|Neutral point of view]]: requires a lack of bias in article prose
*[[Wookieepedia:Spoilers|Spoiler policy]]: explains when new information can be added to the wiki
*[[Wookieepedia:Copyrights|Copyright policy]]: explains how Wookieepedia treats copyrighted material
*For a list of all site policies, click [[Wookieepedia:About|here]].
|}
